results.content: Consumer sentiment fell in August for the first time in three months on a worsening economic outlook, even as expectations for inflation in the year ahead eased. The final reading was slightly improved from the preliminary reading and above the median estimate in a Bloomberg survey of economists. The report also showed that consumers expect prices to rise at an annual rate of 4% over the next year, the lowest reading since March but still historically elevated.
